card.what: Moulded composite two-sheave deck organiser: 40 mm sheaves side by side on upright axles between dog-bone base and top plates, a screw tab at each end, stainless axle heads
card.boats: J/22 hero, one a side on the cabin top aft of the mast, turning the halyards outboard to their cam cleats
card.distance: arm's reach; the crew handles the halyards beside it
card.before: on the J/22 hero an 80 x 120 x 35 mm black box (no kit part)

references.url: 40 mm composite two-sheave organiser listings (marinestore.co.uk, mauripro.com, theboatwarehouse.com.au): 104 mm long, 24 mm high, 70 g; 50 mm model 135 x 31 mm

references.use: the look: black halyard hardware on TX 7295's cabin top aft of the mast (IMG_9224, project files only)

sizes.name: Depth along the lines
sizes.source: not listed; a 40 mm sheave plus the plate's rim (GUESS)

features.text: Two grooved sheaves side by side on upright axles
Dog-bone base and top plates, round over each sheave with a waist between
A screw tab at each end of the base with a countersunk screw
Stainless axle heads with hex sockets on top, stainless bushings
A web joining the plates at the waist
A raised rim round the top plate
Made-up maker's plate at the waist

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter of the triangles
